title: Darkwing's Tweaks - Improved Foliage
description: Makes grass and related blocks look better, less dirt on the sides.
body:
This is a simple resource pack to make the sides of Grass, Mycelium, Podzol, and Paths have less dirt on the side textures.

It is made using MCreator.

I hope you enjoy it, it is part of the Darkwing's Tweaks series.
